reviews.comment: I loved this class. Professor Bankston cares deeply about her students' learning, and she is a great teacher. The writing skills I left with are skills I still use today. While a bit of this class is reading and takes significant time, all of the books chosen are enjoyable.

Prof Bankston is so nice! Her lectures are easy to follow and engaging. The group discussions were also really fun. Good amount of reading but not hard to follow through. The film unit was my favorite! Follow the rubrics and you'll be fine.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: She is the best! I would take her again. A decent amount of reading but she is reasonable. She is so nice and cares about the students and is very understanding.

Prof Bankston is very passionate about her class material and is genuinely one of the sweetest professors on campus. If you're taking her creative writing class, PLEASE read what she assigns. It's always relevant and the class is small, and therefore relies heavily on class discussion. I loved this class and it is not hard to do well in it.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: I couldn't find any information on her but after taking her class I thought I'd let everyone know that she's really good and her class is pretty easy. She assigns lots of readings but I only read like 10% and did just fine. She's very helpful and nice but be prepared to do presentations and more than an average amount of homework. Great class!
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Lots of homework
